purposes.label: Hero
purposes.means: The big opening banner of a page: headline, short text, buttons and a picture.
purposes.settings_hint: variant split|centred|image-bg; CTAs via multi-button; trust chips as children

purposes.label: Page intro
purposes.means: The compact title band at the top of an inner page: eyebrow, title, one line of intro, optional breadcrumb.
purposes.settings_hint: variant compact; no image/CTAs; breadcrumb on
evidence: mamas: Shop heading band, Contact/Help/Basket/Sign-in heroes
purposes.db_check: blocks: sgs/hero (variant_attr=variant); same block as hero, differs in variant and visitor meaning

purposes.label: Breadcrumb
purposes.means: The trail showing where this page sits (Home > Shop > Frame).

purposes.label: Brand marquee
purposes.means: A moving strip of brand logos (brands the shop stocks or the firm owns).
purposes.settings_hint: marquee on; logos from product brands (typed names stand for logos, Eye Care S9); fade edges; pause on hover
purposes.db_check: blocks: sgs/brand-strip 'infinite marquee scroll, fade edges, direction control'

purposes.label: Logo wall
purposes.means: A still grid of logos: partners, accreditations, brands on a brands page.
purposes.settings_hint: marquee off; grid layout; greyscale optional
purposes.db_check: blocks: sgs/brand-strip (same block, marquee off); differs by motion and meaning

purposes.label: Trust ticker
purposes.means: A thin row of short reassurances (free delivery, handmade, registered business), static or scrolling on small screens.
evidence: mamas: S-07 trust bar, S-14 assurance row

purposes.label: Notice bar
purposes.means: A slim announcement or promo line above or inside the header.
evidence: announcement bars on any site (no client declares one as a section
indus Top bar is contact pills)

purposes.label: Google reviews
purposes.means: Customer reviews pulled from the business Google listing, with the overall rating.
purposes.settings_hint: source Google Business Profile; slider|grid; schema on

purposes.label: Trustpilot reviews
purposes.means: Customer reviews in Trustpilot style.
purposes.settings_hint: entered or fetched reviews; official style
evidence: mamas: S-07 #reviews slider (6 Trustpilot reviews), hero "4.3 on Trustpilot"

purposes.label: Testimonials
purposes.means: Hand-picked quotes from named customers or partners, one or a sliding few.
purposes.settings_hint: autoplay; avatar; a single quote uses sgs/testimonial
evidence: indus: Home Our Partners Love Us

purposes.label: Stats
purposes.means: A row of headline numbers (60+ years, 150 countries).
purposes.settings_hint: count-up animation; prefix/suffix; laid out in a container row

purposes.label: Feature grid
purposes.means: A grid of short reasons or benefits, each with an icon, title and line of text.
evidence: indus: Home Why Choose Indus Foods (8 cards)

purposes.label: Feature list
purposes.means: A plain list of points with ticks or icons.
purposes.settings_hint: icon per item; one or two columns

purposes.label: Link cards
purposes.means: Picture cards that each lead to another page (sectors, our story, path choices).
purposes.settings_hint: variant card|overlay; columns 4/2/1; pointer tilt optional
evidence: indus: Home sector cards, blocks "cards", About 8 linked cards
mamas: Who are we baking for path cards, Contact channel cards, gifts tiles
purposes.db_check: blocks: sgs/card-grid 'image and content grid with overlay and card variants'

purposes.label: Category tiles
purposes.means: Browse-by tiles for a product range (frame shapes, gift moments) leading to a filtered shop.
purposes.settings_hint: overlay variant; links carry shop filter query
purposes.db_check: blocks: sgs/card-grid (same block, overlay variant, link target = shop filter)

purposes.label: Text and picture
purposes.means: Copy on one side and a picture on the other, optionally flipped or tinted.
purposes.settings_hint: two-column layout; sgs/media + heading/text/button children; flip; tint
purposes.db_check: blocks: sgs/container 'fundamental building block for all page sections'; sgs/media

purposes.label: How it works
purposes.means: A numbered sequence of steps.
evidence: indus: Home How to open a trade account

purposes.label: Timeline
purposes.means: Milestones in date order (a company history).
purposes.settings_hint: vertical|horizontal; scroll effect (pinned hscroll as scroll effect)
evidence: indus: Home Heritage, blocks "hscroll" (S-17, S-18), template "timeline"

purposes.label: FAQ
purposes.means: Questions and answers that open and close, with FAQ structured data.
purposes.settings_hint: FAQ schema on; first open; optional category chips and search via sgs/filter-search
evidence: mamas: Home FAQ, Help FAQ list

purposes.label: Details accordion
purposes.means: Collapsible detail sections that are not questions (delivery, ingredients, care).

purposes.label: Call to action
purposes.means: A band that asks for one next step (apply, call, buy).
purposes.settings_hint: background colour/gradient; sgs/heading, sgs/text, sgs/multi-button children
evidence: indus: blocks "cta" (most pages), Home final CTA band
purposes.db_check: blocks: sgs/container + sgs/multi-button (no dedicated CTA block)

purposes.label: Team
purposes.means: People behind the business, with photo, role and bio.
evidence: none in the three clients (framework coverage)

purposes.label: Pricing
purposes.means: Plans or price tiers side by side.
evidence: none in the three clients (framework coverage)

purposes.label: Gallery
purposes.means: A set of photos to browse.

purposes.label: Before and after
purposes.means: Two pictures compared with a drag handle.
evidence: none in the three clients (framework coverage)

purposes.label: Countdown
purposes.means: A timer counting to a date (sale, launch, cut-off).
evidence: none in the three clients (framework coverage)

purposes.label: Contact details
purposes.means: Address, phone, email and opening hours.
purposes.settings_hint: fields from Settings > Business Details; hours; social-icons beside

purposes.label: Map
purposes.means: An embedded map of where to visit.
purposes.settings_hint: NO SGS BLOCK: needs a decision
purposes.db_check: gap: no map block in blocks table or src/blocks

purposes.label: Enquiry form
purposes.means: A form to send a message, request or application.
purposes.settings_hint: fields by sgs/form-field-*; consent field; email via Sgs_Mailer

purposes.label: Multi-step form
purposes.means: A long form split into steps with a review at the end.

purposes.label: Newsletter signup
purposes.means: A one-field email signup.

purposes.label: Guided finder
purposes.means: A short question flow that ends in a recommendation.
evidence: mamas: Home Who are we baking for, Gifts finder card

purposes.label: Product builder
purposes.means: Pick base, flavours and pack size to build an item before adding to basket.
purposes.settings_hint: exclusive pill groups; price per pack
evidence: mamas: Home #build, Product buy box builder
purposes.db_check: blocks: sgs/option-picker (single-select only; multi-select flavours is a gap)

purposes.label: Posts list
purposes.means: Latest articles or news cards, optionally filtered by category.

purposes.label: Article body
purposes.means: The long text of one post.
purposes.settings_hint: single template with post-title, post-date, post-time-to-read
purposes.db_check: core/post-content: core/WooCommerce block, not in the SGS blocks table

purposes.label: Rich text
purposes.means: Plain headed copy such as terms or policies.

purposes.label: Shop archive
purposes.means: The browsable product list with filters and sorting.
purposes.settings_hint: sgs/product-card in the template; filters; sort; sgs/filter-search; drawer on small screens
evidence: mamas: S-12 product grid + sort + filter chips
purposes.db_check: blocks: sgs/product-card, sgs/filter-search; Woo: product-collection, product-filters, catalog-sorting

purposes.label: Product row
purposes.means: A curated row of products (best sellers, similar, more from this brand, related).
purposes.settings_hint: query by sales|related|brand; carousel or grid; sgs/product-card
purposes.db_check: woocommerce/product-collection: core/WooCommerce block, not in the SGS blocks table

purposes.label: Product buy box
purposes.means: The product hero: gallery, price, options and add to basket.
purposes.settings_hint: gallery column + config column; option pickers
purposes.db_check: blocks: sgs/buybox 'renders the full product hero'

purposes.label: Product details tabs
purposes.means: Tabbed description, specification and delivery info on a product.

purposes.label: Product reviews
purposes.means: Customer reviews of one product, including the empty state.
purposes.db_check: woocommerce/product-reviews: core/WooCommerce block, not in the SGS blocks table

purposes.label: Product FAQ
purposes.means: Questions about one product with structured FAQ data.

purposes.label: Basket page
purposes.means: The full basket: lines, delivery progress, totals.
purposes.settings_hint: line items; gift toggle and upsell as extensions
purposes.db_check: woocommerce/cart: core/WooCommerce block, not in the SGS blocks table

purposes.label: Basket drawer
purposes.means: The slide-out basket opened from the header.
purposes.db_check: blocks: sgs/cart 'live item-count badge plus flyout or drawer'

purposes.label: Checkout
purposes.means: Details, delivery, payment and express pay, as one or several steps.
purposes.settings_hint: steps follow sgs/form-step surfaces; express pay block
purposes.db_check: woocommerce/checkout: core/WooCommerce block, not in the SGS blocks table

purposes.label: Order confirmation
purposes.means: The thank-you page after paying.
purposes.db_check: woocommerce/order-confirmation: core/WooCommerce block, not in the SGS blocks table

purposes.label: Account area
purposes.means: Signed-in area: orders, details, addresses, subscriptions.

purposes.label: Sign in or register
purposes.means: Login, register and reset password forms.

purposes.label: Site header
purposes.means: The header bar: logo, navigation, search, basket.

purposes.label: Site footer
purposes.means: The footer: contact band, link columns, bottom bar.

purposes.label: Plain container
purposes.means: A section that is only a styled wrapper around other content.

not_purposes.decided_by_surface_kind: mega-menu -> menu/panel kind (sgs/mega-panel); mobile-menu -> drawer (sgs/nav-drawer); size-guide -> modal (sgs/modal); checkout steps -> form-step; whatsapp-fab -> global (sgs/whatsapp-cta floating); toast -> framework behaviour, no block
